waypoints.name: Chelan Butte Trailhead (Iowa Ave)
waypoints.directions: In Chelan, follow SR 150 (E Woodin Ave), turn left on Sanders St, then left on Farnham St, continue onto S Saunders St, and turn left on E Iowa Ave to the trailhead parking lot on the left. A Discover Pass or WDFW Vehicle Access Pass is required to park.

waypoints.name: Chelan Butte Summit
waypoints.directions: Climb the jeep track from the lot and take the marked hiking-trail cutoff about a quarter mile in. The trail climbs steadily with lake views to a short side trip to the Elephant Head viewpoint, then steepens along the ridgeline to the radio and TV towers, where a final 100 ft of road reaches the summit, about 3.7 miles from the trailhead.
